schema.bad_example: string - invalid config snippet that triggers this rule (optional, falls back to category template)

security.cwe: array of CWE IDs, e.g. CWE-798
security.owasp: array of OWASP Top 10 tags, e.g. A07:2021
security.vulnerability_class: short taxonomy class such as hardcoded-secret or command-injection
